cards.ex: We're keeping the project under wraps until it's ready to launch.
cards.exUz: Loyihani ishga tushirishga tayyor bo'lgunimizcha sir saqlayapmiz.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida ma'lumotni yashirish, oshkor qilmaslik.

cards.ex: The deal was negotiated behind closed doors.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv yopiq eshiklar ortida muhokama qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Ommadan yashirincha, maxfiy uchrashuv yoki muhokama.

cards.ex: The new product launch is very hush-hush.
cards.exUz: Yangi mahsulotning ishga tushirilishi juda maxfiy.
cards.uzDef: O'ta maxfiy, hech kim bilmasligi kerak.

cards.ex: Don't spill the beans about the surprise party!
cards.exUz: Syurpriz kechasi haqida sirni ochma!
cards.uzDef: Sirni tasodifan yoki ataylab oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: We're doing this on the QT, so don't tell anyone.
cards.exUz: Biz buni jimlikda qilyapmiz, shuning uchun hech kimga aytma.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy ravishda, hech kimga aytmasdan.

cards.ex: It's a private matter, and I don't want to discuss it.
cards.exUz: Bu shaxsiy masala va men uni muhokama qilishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga tegishli bo'lmagan shaxsiy ish.

cards.ex: I promised to keep mum about their engagement.
cards.exUz: Men ularning unashtiruvi haqida jim turishga va'da berdim.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsa aytmaslik, sirni saqlash.

cards.ex: He's trying to stay under the radar after the scandal.
cards.exUz: U janjaldan keyin e'tibordan chetda qolishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sezilmaslikka harakat qilish, e'tibordan chetda qolish.

cards.ex: Their meeting had a real cloak and dagger feel to it.
cards.exUz: Ularning uchrashuvi haqiqiy maxfiy faoliyatga o'xshardi.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy va shubhali harakatlar.

cards.ex: This document contains confidential information.
cards.exUz: Ushbu hujjatda maxfiy ma'lumot mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Oshkor qilinmasligi kerak bo'lgan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: Off the record, I think he's going to resign.
cards.exUz: Yozuvsiz aytganda, menimcha u iste'foga chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Rasman emas, nashr etilmaydigan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: Her personal life is a closed book to most people.
cards.exUz: Uning shaxsiy hayoti ko'pchilik uchun yopiq kitobdir.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish qiyin bo'lgan yoki sir saqlanadigan narsa.

cards.ex: The scandal involved a major cover-up.
cards.exUz: Janjal katta yashirishni o'z ichiga olgan.
cards.uzDef: Noqonuniy yoki xato narsani yashirishga urinish.

cards.ex: Can you keep a secret? I have some exciting news.
cards.exUz: Sir saqlay olasizmi? Menda ajoyib yangiliklar bor.
cards.uzDef: Sirni boshqalarga aytmaslik.

cards.ex: I don't want to pry into your personal life.
cards.exUz: Men sizning shaxsiy hayotingizga aralashishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Birovning shaxsiy ishlariga ruxsatsiz aralashish.

cards.ex: I'm telling you this in confidence.
cards.exUz: Men sizga buni ishonch bilan aytyapman.
cards.uzDef: Sir saqlash sharti bilan, maxfiy ravishda.

cards.ex: The recipe is a closely guarded trade secret.
cards.exUz: Retsept - bu qattiq qo'riqlanadigan tijorat siri.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning raqobatbardoshligini ta'minlovchi maxfiy ma'lumot.

cards.ex: He had to pull some strings to get the job.
cards.exUz: U ishga kirish uchun bir nechta ipni tortishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning foydasi uchun maxfiy ta'sir ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Taking photos without permission is a violation of privacy.
cards.exUz: Ruxsatsiz suratga olish shaxsiy hayotni buzishdir.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy hayotga qonunsiz aralashish.

cards.ex: Just keep schtum about the whole thing.
cards.exUz: Faqat bu haqda jim bo'ling.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsa aytmaslik, jim turish.

cards.ex: He tried to cover his tracks, but the police found out.
cards.exUz: U izlarini yashirishga harakat qildi, lekin politsiya bilib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noqonuniy ish qilganingni yashirishga urinish.

cards.ex: Mum's the word about the surprise.
cards.exUz: Syurpriz haqida jimjitlik.
cards.uzDef: Hech kimga aytma, sirni saqla.

cards.ex: The letter was marked 'private and confidential'.
cards.exUz: Xatga 'shaxsiy va maxfiy' deb yozilgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Faqatgina ko'rsatilgan shaxs tomonidan o'qilishi kerak bo'lgan ma'lumot.

cards.ex: Information is shared on a need-to-know basis.
cards.exUz: Ma'lumot bilish zarurati asosida almashiladi.
cards.uzDef: Faqat bilishi kerak bo'lganlarga ma'lumot berish.

cards.ex: The whistleblower exposed the corruption.
cards.exUz: Fosh qiluvchi korrupsiyani fosh qildi.
cards.uzDef: Noqonuniy faoliyat haqida xabar beruvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: Someone leaked the information to the press.
cards.exUz: Kimdir ma'lumotni matbuotga sizdirdi.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy ma'lumotni noqonuniy ravishda oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: The tabloid tried to dig up dirt on the politician.
cards.exUz: Gazeta siyosatchi haqida kir izlashga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birov haqida salbiy ma'lumot izlash.

cards.ex: He tends to keep his cards close to his chest.
cards.exUz: U o'z fikrlarini yashirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrlari yoki rejalarini boshqalarga aytmaslik.

cards.ex: There was a serious breach of confidentiality.
cards.exUz: Jiddiy sir buzilishi sodir bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Maxfiy ma'lumotni oshkor qilish.

cards.ex: They had to redact the document before releasing it.
cards.exUz: Ular hujjatni chiqarishdan oldin tahrirlashlari kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Hujjatdan maxfiy ma'lumotni olib tashlash.
